promptLines: Asset type: reusable upper-body anime visual-novel standing sprite, neutral expression, chroma-key source
Input images: Image 1 is the identity, outfit, and illustration-style reference for Mio Amamiya; it is not a background or composition reference.
Primary request: Generate a clean reusable neutral-expression sprite of exactly the same Mio Amamiya shown in Image 1.

Subject identity lock: explicitly 23-year-old adult woman; preserve her exact mature facial structure, teal-gray eye shape and color, dark-indigo shoulder-length bob with soft inward curl and side-swept fringe, small gold four-point star hairpin, skin tone, adult proportions, and overall silhouette.

Wardrobe lock: preserve the same professional navy knit research cardigan, ivory mock-neck blouse, amber-gold buttons, and slim amber pendant necklace exactly; no additions, removals, recoloring, or redesign.
Expression: reserved attentiveness with relaxed brows, steady gaze toward viewer, closed lips, and a faint professional half-smile; no blush, tears, or exaggerated emotion.

Pose and framing lock: portrait 2:3 canvas; identical canonical upper-body framing intended for a four-expression sprite set; top of hair through natural waist visible; head centered, shoulders level, torso turned only slightly three-quarter while face looks toward viewer; both complete shoulders and cardigan front visible; arms relaxed but hands remain outside the bottom edge; generous even padding around hair and shoulders.
Style/medium: match Image 1’s polished contemporary Japanese visual-novel anime rendering, clean expressive linework, soft cel shading, controlled highlights, premium dating-sim finish.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local background removal.
Lighting: soft neutral studio-like character lighting with a very subtle cool blue-hour rim, consistent across the future expression set.

Constraints: the background must be one uniform #00ff00 color with no shadows, gradient, texture, reflections, floor plane, halo, vignette, scenery, props, cast shadow, or lighting variation; keep the subject fully separated from the background with crisp antialiased edges; do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject; no text, labels, logo, signature, border, UI, speech bubble, or watermark; exactly one adult character.
Avoid: full-body framing; cropped hair; cut shoulders; visible hands; school uniform; childlike or chibi proportions; sexualized framing; photorealism; 3D-render look; magenta key background.
